title: It's so incredibly exhausting to constantly see people...
content: It's so incredibly exhausting to constantly see people fighting about politics. I used to really love Twitter and that's eroding fast.

title: The incessant name-calling, assumption of negative intent,...
content: The incessant name-calling, assumption of negative intent, and rallying cries on both sides have worn me down.

title: I can see very clearly now how clickbait culture is even...
content: I can see very clearly now how clickbait culture is even affecting how we chose our president and how we talk about it. It's disheartening.

title: Everywhere I look lately, it's just mud-slinging, an \"us...
content: Everywhere I look lately, it's just mud-slinging, an "us vs. them" mentality, and headlines designed to reinforce either side's opinions.

title: Twitter used to be fun. I joined because I was looking for...
content: Twitter used to be fun. I joined because I was looking for a place to talk to interesting people who enjoyed the same things I did.

title: It was like a cocktail party. Lots of short conversations...
content: It was like a cocktail party. Lots of short conversations with people who were all together in the same room for the same purpose.

title: Lately, it's begun to feel like that cocktail party has...
content: Lately, it's begun to feel like that cocktail party has gone on about an hour too long. The guests are getting cranky and they're fighting.

title: So the logical conclusion is to either stop talking to the...
content: So the logical conclusion is to either stop talking to the cranky guests or leave the party completely and go home.

title: I've really enjoyed the party, and I'd rather not leave....
content: I've really enjoyed the party, and I'd rather not leave. But some of the conversations are getting to be toxic. So I have a decision to make

title: I used to value Twitter as a secondary news source. Now I'm...
content: I used to value Twitter as a secondary news source. Now I'm thinking of muting any key words having to do with the election results.
